verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ rādhaṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: When Venerable Rādha was seated to one side, the Buddha said to him:

verses.pali: “yo kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: “Rādha, you should give up any desire, any greed, any desire and greed for whatever is liable to cease.
And what is liable to cease?

verses.pali: Rūpaṁ kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: Form is liable to cease. You should give up any desire, any greed, any desire and greed for it.

verses.pali: viññāṇaṁ nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: Consciousness is liable to cease. You should give up any desire, any greed, any desire and greed for it.

verses.pali: Yo kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
verses.english: You should give up any desire, any greed, any desire and greed for whatever is liable to cease.”
The Linked Discourses with Rādha are complete.
